name: md_broken_links
description: Scans all .md files under a docs dir for broken relative links (missing file or missing heading fragment, GitHub-style slugs), ignoring fenced code blocks and http/https/mailto. Writes the sorted unique JSON array of '<file>: <target>' to an output file and returns it with counts.
whenToUse: Whenever the docs broken-link check is requested; prefer over ad-hoc scripts.

docsDir.description: Docs dir relative to project root

out.description: Output JSON path relative to project root

provenance.reason: docs link check will be requested repeatedly as docs are rewritten
